body: Task M1.5 (docs/work-plan.md): Compatibility check — run the workshop factory on acp instead of handoff with no behavior change. The acp-backed handoff shim is already merged (PRs #1, #3; see agent-comms/). The done check is a real run: exercise the workshop factory flow end to end with the shim in place of the reference handoff, compare behavior against the reference, and record the evidence. Work on branch sbx/m1.5-compat-run. Tick M1.5 in the work plan only if the run really passes; otherwise leave it unticked with a note on what failed.
